title: XDrip not backfilling data to nightscout
symptom: xDrip+ is uploading current blood sugar readings to Nightscout, but it has not uploaded several months of back data after about 18 hours of setup.
cause: xDrip+ will not load data that was not set to be uploaded when it was created.
fix: The latest nightly has an option to backfill data. Find it in Settings -> Cloud Upload -> API Upload -> Extra Options -> Back fill data.
evidence_quote: The latest nightly has an option to backfill data. Find it in `Settings` -> `Cloud Upload` -> `API Upload` -> `Extra Options` ->`Back fill data`
